ryubing.name: Ryubing (Ryujinx)
ryubing.note: The actively maintained continuation of Ryujinx. The original Ryujinx project was discontinued.

noCopiesNote: Nova Forge does not sell or provide copies of any third-party game — not even free ones. You need your own legally obtained copy.
nintendoNote: Nintendo games can only be used on PC from a dump of a copy you own, made from your own console. Nova Forge does not provide dumps, keys, or firmware.
